mapper.select: SELECT image_data FROM user_avatar WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE publisher_userstudent_user SET avatar_version=#{version} WHERE id=#{id}

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job WHERE publisher_id=#{userId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE student_id=#{userId}

mapper.select: SELECT j.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status<>'WITHDRAWN') AS application_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a WHERE a.job_id=j.id AND a.status='ACTIVE') AS accepted_count FROM job j WHERE publisher_id=#{publisherId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.id AS application_id,a.status AS application_status,a.created_at AS accepted_at,j.status AS job_status,j.recruitment_mode,j.id,j.title,j.location,j.pay,j.pay_unit,j.publisher_id,u.organization,p.amount_cents AS paid_cents,p.created_at AS paid_at FROM job_application a JOIN job j ON j.id=a.job_id JOIN publisher_user u ON u.id=j.publisher_id LEFT JOIN job_payment p ON p.application_id=a.id WHERE a.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM job WHERE id=#{id} AND publisher_id=#{publisherId}

SELECT a.id AS application_id,a.status AS application_status,a.created_at AS accepted_at,a.reviewed_at,a.resume_cipher,u.id,u.role,u.nickname,u.avatar_version,u.grade,u.major,u.school,u.name_cipher,u.student_number_cipher,p.amount_cents AS paid_cents FROM job_application a JOIN student_user u ON u.id=a.student_id LEFT JOIN job_payment p ON p.application_id=a.id WHERE a.job_id=#{jobId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status<>'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE job_id=#{jobId}
